## Overview

This file reports research finding from 2026 canola field trials conducted in Minnesota. Experiments include:

1.  nrt_can_26 - Nitrogen rate by timing conducted at the Canola Production Centre (CPC), Magnusson Research Farm (MAG), and the UMN St. Paul Campus (SP).

2.  of_can_26 - A subset of the treatments were tested on-farm.

3.  sr_can_26 - A sulfur fertilization experiment conducted at MAG and SP

4.  v_can_26 - A variety trial conducted at CPC

```{r cars}
summary(cars)
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
